Project.name: MAX Dobro
Project.annotation: Volunteer and charity platform that gamifies good deeds: events, courses, karma, stories, and organizer tools, delivered as a NestJS API, React mini-app, and MAX/Telegram bots.
Project.keywords: volunteer, charity, karma, events, courses, stories, organizer, NestJS, React, Prisma, Supabase, MAX, Telegram

Actors.actor-Volunteer: Registered user who discovers events, learns, earns karma, and participates in the social feed.
Actors.actor-Organizer: User bound to an organization who creates events, reviews participants, and reads dashboard stats.
Actors.actor-Guest: Unauthenticated visitor who can browse public surfaces until login is required.
Actors.actor-System: Backend schedulers, Supabase webhooks, and bot processes that sync identity or send reminders.

UC-001.Action: Finds a first volunteer event from the feed or map
UC-001.Goal: Join a nearby or matching event and start earning hours and karma
UC-001.Preconditions: App is reachable; events exist in the database
UC-001.AcceptanceCriteria: Event list or map markers load; event detail shows organization, date, and participate action

UC-002.Action: Creates and publishes an event, then reviews volunteer applications
UC-002.Goal: Staff an event with approved participants
UC-002.Preconditions: User has organizer role and organizationId
UC-002.AcceptanceCriteria: Event is persisted; participant status can be approved or rejected

UC-003.Action: Signs in via MAX, Telegram, or email/password
UC-003.Goal: Obtain an app session and a backend user record
UC-003.Preconditions: Matching auth secrets and provider init data are available
UC-003.AcceptanceCriteria: Login returns a session user; subsequent profile requests are authorized

UC-004.Action: Completes a course lesson, quiz, and certificate path
UC-004.Goal: Learn required skills and keep progress on the server
UC-004.AcceptanceCriteria: Lesson completion persists; course completion can issue a certificate

UC-005.Action: Publishes a story, comments, and likes
UC-005.Goal: Share event impressions with the community
UC-005.Preconditions: User is authenticated; optional event link exists
UC-005.AcceptanceCriteria: Story appears in the feed; like and comment mutate the story record

UC-006.Action: Spends karma in the rewards shop
UC-006.Goal: Purchase a virtual reward without going negative
UC-006.Preconditions: User has enough karmaPoints; reward is in catalog
UC-006.AcceptanceCriteria: Purchase deducts karma and records UserReward

UC-007.Goal: Compare activity and claim bonus challenge progress
UC-007.Preconditions: Users have karma or hours; a weekly challenge is active
UC-007.AcceptanceCriteria: Leaderboard ranks users; weekly challenge payload is returned

UC-008.Goal: Get navigation help without leaving the mini-app
UC-008.AcceptanceCriteria: Message history loads; posting a message stores user and assistant replies

UC-009.Action: Views friends and event chat history
UC-009.AcceptanceCriteria: Friends list and event messages load for the current user

UC-010.Action: Opens the MAX or Telegram bot and launches the mini-app
UC-010.Goal: Reach the product from messenger without a separate install
UC-010.Preconditions: Bot tokens and MINI_APP_URL are configured
UC-010.AcceptanceCriteria: Bot answers start/help and exposes a link or web_app button to the mini-app

NonGoals.item-1: No public marketplace or payments beyond in-app karma rewards.
NonGoals.item-2: No native iOS/Android apps; the client is a web mini-app.
NonGoals.item-3: No change to runtime behavior while applying GRACE markup.

Constraints.constraint-1: Primary database is PostgreSQL via Prisma, typically hosted on Supabase.
Constraints.constraint-2: Frontend can run against mock or real APIs through VITE_API_MODE.
Constraints.constraint-3: Secrets, tokens, and init data must never appear in logs.
Constraints.constraint-4: Course progress is server-backed; localStorage is not the source of truth.
Constraints.constraint-5: Organizer APIs require an authenticated user with organizer role and organization binding.

Risks.risk-1: Auth spans MAX, Telegram, email/password, and Supabase webhooks; identity linking can drift if webhook and login paths disagree.
Risks.risk-2: Mock API mode can hide backend contract mismatches until VITE_API_MODE=real.
Risks.risk-3: Karma mutations (events, rewards, challenges) must stay consistent with User.karmaPoints.

OpenQuestions.question-1: This GRACE overlay is retrospective on an already-shipped codebase; docs describe current public modules rather than a greenfield plan.
